svg.title: GSDF/CSDF drawing surfaces affected by adjustment versus fixed references
svg.desc: A two-column Traditional Chinese diagram. The left column lists surfaces that follow current Lmax, Gamma, Filter amount, Levels, route, and Dither settings. The right column lists fixed reference surfaces that remain stable for comparison.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 繪製區：會受調整影響 vs 固定參考

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 左側會跟著目前 transfer table 或後級 filter 變動；右側保留穩定基準，方便檢查顯示與縮放。
